runs.summary:
📋 Weekly Review Digest

Issues Found
- crypto-trading — Daily runs halted; overseer-status.json stale ~6.4 days (no runs since 2026-07-07, failing silently). #34

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. overseer — Per-project freshness SLA + staleness alerts in digest (effort: low, impact: high): the crypto feed sat 153h stale while overseer stayed quiet — surface silent staleness at top of digest. (Directly prevents repeats of issue #34.)
2. crypto-trading — Signal reject-funnel report from existing thresholds (effort: low, impact: high): 10 signals evaluated, 0 acted — show the binding constraint to tell mis-tuned from structurally idle.
3. ufc-dashboard — Detect fighter-swap/bout-replacement to suppress phantom alerts (effort: medium, impact: high): impossible magnitudes (983, -245) are substitutions diffed as odds moves — restore alert trust.
4. coachvision — Per-technique coaching feedback w/ confidence scores (effort: medium, impact: high): segmentation works but nothing consumes it — build the layer that gives users a reason to upload clips.
5. ufc-dashboard — Rank/badge alerts by main-event weight + time-to-event (effort: low, impact: medium): main events are buried under raw magnitude.
6. crypto-trading — Buy-and-hold benchmark + rolling alpha on equity curve (effort: low, impact: medium): scalars already exist (-10.7% alpha) — make underperformance visually obvious.

Weekly Digest

Issues Found
- Overseer — CONFIRMED: total GitHub API auth failure. Every tool (all reads, search, file_issue) returns 401 "Bad credentials". Overseer is fully blind: can't read any of the 3 projects, can't check its own health, can't dedupe or file issues. Root cause: dead/expired/misconfigured GitHub token shared by all tools.
- ⚠️ Self-file failed — the write path is broken by the same 401, so this ticket could NOT be auto-created. Manual action needed: rotate the overseer's GitHub PAT and verify scopes (repo read on all 4 repos + issues write).
- crypto-trading / coachvision / ufc-dashboard — no project bugs confirmed; all data reads were blocked by the same 401, so nothing could be verified this cycle.

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. Overseer — Startup auth health-check (effort: low, impact: high): validate the GitHub credential at startup and fail loudly / alert on a dead token, instead of silently blinding every review and project check like it did this week.

📋 Weekly Overseer Digest

⚠️ Both agents were blocked all cycle: the overseer's shared GitHub token returned 401 Bad credentials on every read/search/write call. crypto-trading, coachvision, and ufc-dashboard were NOT assessed — their true health is unknown until auth is fixed and the review is re-run.

Issues Found
- overseer — Shared GitHub token returns 401 "Bad credentials" on all tools (read, search, AND file_issue). Overseer is fully blind and cannot even file this bug via the normal path. Needs manual fix: rotate token, verify scopes (repo read + issues write), and add a startup auth pre-flight. (3 projects unreadable as a result.)

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. overseer — Per-tool credential preflight + graceful degradation with status badges (effort: low, impact: high): validate creds at run start and show per-project "available / auth failed / not configured" — directly prevents this week's silent whole-cycle blindness.
2. crypto-trading — Per-strategy risk-adjusted metrics (Sharpe, max drawdown, expectancy) in the daily log (effort: low, impact: high): compare strategies on risk, not just raw P&L; persist a JSON time series for trending.
3. overseer — Weekly digest notification via email/Discord (effort: low, impact: high): push the summary automatically instead of relying on visiting the dashboard, closing the pipeline loop.
4. ufc-dashboard — Odds-movement history with line-movement alerts (effort: medium, impact: high): persist timestamped odds snapshots, chart movement, flag notable movers past a probability threshold.
5. coachvision — Auto-generated per-session coaching highlight reel from key-technique + low-confidence frames (effort: medium, impact: medium): reuse existing detection timestamps to stitch clips for coaching and to spot where the model needs training data.

Weekly Overseer Digest

Issues Found
- overseer — GitHub token invalid: all read/search/file tools return `401 Bad credentials`. Overseer was fully blind this cycle and couldn't even file this bug itself. MANUAL FIX: rotate the PAT, verify scopes (repo read + issues write), then re-run to backfill the skipped crypto-trading / coachvision / ufc-dashboard checks. (The per-project "couldn't read" notes are all symptoms of this one root cause.)

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. overseer — Credential preflight + graceful degradation (effort: low, impact: high): validate token at startup and normalize auth failures into structured "not_configured" payloads so one expired secret can't blind the whole pipeline — exactly today's failure.
2. crypto-trading — Structured daily run summary as JSONL (effort: low, impact: high): P&L, fills, slippage, equity, errors as a queryable time series; unlocks dashboards + backtesting.
3. overseer — Golden-file unit tests + CI for tracer/read-tool parsers (effort: low, impact: medium): catch schema drift before the weekly run.
4. overseer — Cache last-successful read snapshots, serve stale-with-timestamp on failure (effort: medium, impact: high): keeps reviews useful during outages/expired creds.
5. ufc-dashboard — Track odds movement with line-move / CLV alerts (effort: medium, impact: high): highest-value signal the scraper currently discards.
6. crypto-trading — Regime filter + volatility-scaled position sizing (effort: medium, impact: high): constant risk budget, better risk-adjusted P&L; backtestable on existing logs.
7. coachvision — Kalman/optical-flow ball-track interpolation + smoothing (effort: medium, impact: high): bridges detection gaps for cleaner trajectories, no retraining.

📋 Weekly Review Digest

⚠️ Heads-up: The GitHub token behind ALL overseer tools returned 401 this run. Nothing could be read or filed — crypto-trading, coachvision, and ufc-dashboard went UNREVIEWED. Rotate the credential and re-run to get real project coverage.

Issues Found
- OVERSEER — All GitHub-authed tools (reads, search, file_issue) fail with persistent 401 "Bad credentials"; token is expired/revoked. Overseer is fully blind and could not even file this bug itself. Manual token rotation required out-of-band.

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. OVERSEER — Credential preflight + graceful degradation (effort: low, impact: high): Validate token at startup and map 401/403 to a structured "not_configured" payload so a bad token can't silently kill the whole review — exactly what broke this week.
2. OVERSEER — Weekly digest notifier via webhook (effort: low, impact: high): Config-gated end-of-pipeline notification so you get passive weekly awareness without opening the dashboard.
3. UFC-DASHBOARD — Freshness badge + scraper self-heal/fallback (effort: low, impact: medium): Timestamp scrapes, show a staleness badge, and fall back to secondary source/last-good cache so stale data never looks fresh.
4. CRYPTO-TRADING — Per-strategy risk guardrails (effort: medium, impact: high): Pre-trade drawdown circuit-breaker + position-size cap to protect capital regardless of signal quality.
5. CRYPTO-TRADING — Backtest harness for the live signal function (effort: medium, impact: high): Replay cached OHLCV to measure win rate/Sharpe/drawdown before shipping changes — safe iteration + regression protection.
6. UFC-DASHBOARD — Odds-movement tracking + line-movement alerts (effort: medium, impact: high): Snapshot and diff odds between runs to surface significant implied-probability shifts from data already scraped.
7. COACHVISION — Auto-flag low-confidence frames into a review queue (effort: medium, impact: medium): Route uncertain frames to a labeling manifest to build a fine-tuning set and a self-improving accuracy loop.

STALENESS ALERTS
- coachvision — data 85.1h old, SLA 48h · stale 1 cycle

📋 Weekly Review — 2026-08-13

Issues Found
- ufc-dashboard (#66): Scraper parse-failure on 2026-08-22 Hernandez vs Rodrigues — page fetches but 0 bouts extracted (bout_count 8), so event carries no odds; masked by 100% run success. Watch: UFC 330 line flagged stale <2 days out (not filed).
- Note: coachvision is idle/stale (no footage ever ingested) but self-test passes — monitoring gap, not a bug.

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. crypto-trading — Signal-proximity telemetry panel (effort: low, impact: high): 0/10 signals acted; chart distance-to-trigger to see if market's quiet vs thresholds miscalibrated. No capital at risk. (#38)
2. ufc-dashboard — Push line-movement alerts to Telegram/Discord (effort: low, impact: high): movement data already computed but stuck in JSON; add webhook sink w/ dedup for real-time odds tracking. (#67)
3. overseer — Dead-man's-switch heartbeat alert (effort: low, impact: high): overseer ran 1×/7d (78h stale); independent freshness ping removes the SPOF that would silently blind all monitoring. (#17)
4. crypto-trading — Walk-forward backtest + param-sweep harness (effort: high, impact: high): 90d P&L -793, Sharpe -2.71 is systematic; offline replay quantifies whether an edge exists before risking changes. (#39)
5. coachvision — Bundled demo clip + auto report (effort: medium, impact: medium): reuse passing 77-frame fixture to auto-produce a sample report, lowering activation barrier and exercising the report path. (#21)
6. ufc-dashboard — Per-bout CLV history + steam-move flags (effort: medium, impact: medium): persist timestamped odds to compute closing-line value and detect sharp moves. (#68)

STALENESS ALERTS
- coachvision — data 122.8h old, SLA 48h · stale 5 cycles

Issues Found
- coachvision: pipeline still frozen since 2026-08-10 (now 122.8h old, breaches 48h SLA) — already tracked as open #23, no new bug filed (duplicate condition).
- No other new bugs this week. crypto-trading, ufc-dashboard, and overseer all healthy (fresh runs, no errors). Known non-bugs: crypto-trading's negative P&L/Sharpe (tracked in #41/#42), ufc-dashboard's odds_budget_exhausted (#73, expected state).

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. overseer — Enhancement-backlog aging tracker (effort: low, impact: medium): Cheap addition to the digest that surfaces untriaged ideas sitting 60+ days, making backlog rot visible alongside pipeline staleness.
2. crypto-trading — Transaction-cost-aware signal gate (effort: medium, impact: high): Directly targets the root cause of the ongoing negative P&L/Sharpe -2.29 by suppressing trades whose edge doesn't clear real fees+slippage.
3. coachvision — Cloud/action-camera auto-import connector (effort: medium, impact: high): Likely fixes the real reason footage never gets ingested (manual copy friction) — more impactful than just tracking the staleness.
4. ufc-dashboard — Fighter-history/style-matchup predictive overlay (effort: high, impact: high): Valuable new signal (model vs market probability divergence) but biggest lift — good next-quarter candidate, not urgent.
